mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.cover_image AS coverImage, p.price, p.original_price AS originalPrice, p.brand, p.model, p.condition_level AS conditionLevel, p.warranty, p.status, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, u.id AS sellerId, u.nickname AS sellerNickname, u.avatar AS sellerAvatar FROM biz_favorite f INNER JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = f.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC
